'''Fellan''' was young male courier who worked in [[Narloch]]'s [[Casino/Legends|casinos]] on [[Reaper's World/Legends|Reaper's World]]. He approached a group of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] and offered to sell them proof that Narloch was working for [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]]. He wanted 2000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for the evidence which included recorded conversations of Narloch and [[Bib Fortuna/Legends|Bib Fortuna]], two sets of financial records showing profit skimming and tax fraud, and recorded conversations of Narloch threatening other local casino operators.
